program.name: shieldedPool
docs: Native Pinocchio program. Custom wincode instructions and Borsh self-CPI events. Tree internals intentionally omitted; configuration and asset accounts are described.

accounts.name: newAuthority
docs: Required only for ProtocolAuthority (variant 0); address must equal the instruction payload. Omitted for other updates.

instructions.name: closeNullifierPdas
docs: Remaining accounts: writable nullifier PDAs to close.

instructions.name: emitEvent
docs: Unvalidated no-op. These schemas describe recognized event bodies. Decoding alone does not authenticate an event: require a successful state-changing SPP direct parent and the matching event kind.

instructions.name: deposit
docs: Remaining accounts in assets order: SOL = system program, interface; SPL = token program, mint, user token, interface. Owner is a hash; viewTag is not a verified wallet address.

instructions.name: transact
docs: Remaining accounts, in order: writable input trees (one per treeContexts entry), writable nullifier PDAs (one per input), owner signers, then settlement groups in interfaceTransfers order. SOL: interface, public account. SPL deposit: mint, interface, authority, user token, token program. SPL withdrawal: CPI authority, mint, interface, user token, token program.

instructions.name: mergeTransact
docs: Remaining accounts: one writable nullifier PDA per nullifier, in nullifiers order.

instructions.name: ringDeposit
docs: Remaining accounts in assets order: SOL = system program, interface; SPL = token program, mint, user token, interface. Owner is a hash; viewTag is not a verified wallet address.

instructions.name: ringTransact
docs: Remaining accounts, in order: writable input trees (one per treeContexts entry), writable nullifier PDAs (one per input), owner signers, then settlement groups in interfaceTransfers order. SOL: interface, public account. SPL deposit: mint, interface, authority, user token, token program. SPL withdrawal: CPI authority, mint, interface, user token, token program.

instructions.name: ringMergeTransact
docs: Remaining accounts: one writable nullifier PDA per nullifier, in nullifiers order.

instructions.name: ringAuthorityTransact
docs: Remaining accounts, in order: writable input trees (one per treeContexts entry), writable nullifier PDAs (one per input), owner signers, then settlement groups in interfaceTransfers order. SOL: interface, public account. SPL deposit: mint, interface, authority, user token, token program. SPL withdrawal: CPI authority, mint, interface, user token, token program.
